prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE static opaque 16:9 landscape background plate for a 2D side-view fighting game. Exact subject: STEEL ZONE, Zone19 in Silent Hill: Book of Memories (PS Vita 2012), based on the supplied gameplay storyboard sheets and original Miguel Rico metal props. First two refs are grids ONLY FOR REFERENCE, output one seamless uninterrupted room, no montage. The native gameplay shows green-gray industrial metal room panels and dirty metal floor, large circular gear-shaped floor inserts, riveted rectangular wall framing, dull bright oblong/rectangular light panels and industrial doors; preserve this subdued green-gray and oxidized steel appearance. Third ref supplies the diamond-tread double-panel steel door material, fourth ref the three-spoked toothed disc motif. Do not copy text, humans, monsters, HUD, attacks, maps, menu or the black gaps between reference cells. Create a level SIDE-ON fighting camera, NOT isometric/top-down. Compose one modest industrial room with rear wall of rectangular riveted dark steel panels, one closed diamond-tread double door offset left, dim narrow institutional white light panels and very restrained green cast. A large three-spoked gear motif appears as an INERT inset into the rear floor behind the fighter footing, partly foreshortened, based on original source prop. No invented giant rotating machine, sci-fi screens, pipes everywhere or symbol runes. Wide continuous unbroken worn metal floor occupies lower 28 percent, a straight empty footing at y=0.87, with central86 percent unobstructed. Keep source room's ordinary low-ceiling utilitarian scale. Detailed realistic raster textures, enough diffuse light to read fighter silhouettes, no glossy modern spaceship finish. No characters, bodies, weapons, projectiles, fire, glowing magic, readable text, logos, watermarks, frame or collage. A source-guided fighting-camera adaptation; do not invent hidden lore.
